pages.text:
I'll wait for your reply. I love you.

Yo I suck at starting this. But long story short. This an apology letter.

The time I am writing this isn't influenced by anything that recently happened. As it took me months to write this and honestly Im unsure if you will ever read this.

I really am sorry for everything I did. I won't explain anything unless you need me to. I used to be curious about many many many things before, always wanting the answers, but I learnt that there is peace in not knowing, not asking, not doubting and most importantly not assuming,

I am sorry in general, for everything that I did - that you didn't argue about either. I am sorry for being verbal but also physical. I know a lot of everything that went wrong would have been avoided if I listened to your criticism instead of defending and justifying my actions.

There are other pages too,  do read those. But I just want to say I don't regret caring about you, I regret how far I took it.

Dorin,
I really mean it when I say sorry. I mean it because I know my wrongs, I know where I was right, and more importantly, I know what wrongs I should never repeat.
I hope you forgive me. Even if you don't, I just hope you don't hate me, because I tried being a good bestfriend, but I took it for granted. I hope I haven't misacted or misbehaved before or after writing this letter. Of course, you don't know when I'm writing it, so I mean that in general. If a single infuriating word has come out of my mouth (except me trying to ragebait), I hope you forgive that too. And fuck that badmouthed proyash.

I hope that when we're having a good time, good conversations, good interactions, and I'm hopefully in a humorous mood if I somehow make you laugh you don't let the past ruin that moment by picturing the "true colors" of me. I understand why you may have felt that way before, but I don't want to be that person again.

I don't want you to worry about how I think  or how my mind works, If I feel like talking to you, I'll message you first. I'll reply whenever I see your message, no matter how long you took to reply. I'm not going to sit there waiting for your first text out of some weird ego, and I'll probably still keep sharing reels whether you see them or not. And of course if I don't text or send anything, it is probably for my schedule.

I just hope everything I wrote here is something I'm actually doing, not just saying, because actions speak louder than words ever will.

I know you might not even want to keep talking to me, but if we do, just be comfortable. Speak freely. I won't judge you. I may argue if you're blatantly wrong, but when have you ever been wrong, right.

You handled things much more maturely than I did. I still think your quirky, nekami behavior is part of what makes you, you.

Lastly, I'll state a line from one of my favourite rom-coms:

"But mostly I hate the way I don't hate you.
Not even close,
Not even a little bit,
Not even at all."

:)
The next page is very honest from me.
It might say alot of things you dont expect, or maybe do.

But I really hate things left unsaid.
So, please read the next page.

I love so much about you. I love when you do the :P thing with you tongue. I love how from my perspective, your lips don't fully close when you smile and a tiny part of your teeth shows, and I find it adorable. I love when you genuinely smile your eyes squint, your cheek puffs up, yours lips spread wide, and you always tilt your face slightly upwards. I love that your upper teeth are so perfectly straight but even more i love the crookedness of your lower teeth, and it's weird how it's opposite for me, crooked upper teeth and almost perfect lower teeth. I love the way you talk, the way you shy off to laugh, and I love the way you act towards a person you like, even if it isn't me. I loved the way we talked, free truly, expressive, cute, romantic at times and there for each other. "Loved" because we don't anymore and well it's my fault for that. Love the way I loved you. I love you. For the last 2 years I have not loved someone more than I have loved you. You were my greatest happiness, but you were also my greatest upset, AND ALL THAT WHEN WE DIDN'T EVEN DATE. It's ALWAYS been you, EVERYTHING has been about you, the songs, in them I hear you, movies, romcoms, all that I watch makes me think about how I could have learned from these shows earlier and not be so shitty. I truly loved you because I don't know why I love you. I can't, I couldn't give up, if I took everyone's advice and moved on that wouldn't be love, that would be some other disposable thing. Observations are a double edged sword aren't they, sometimes appreciation gets mixed  up with judgement and those who have only love to provide, pictures to frame of their lover, carry the portrait at deaths bed, are adding fuel to the fire of insecurities. 

By that last line I metaphorically mean: I love all your characteristics , in my eyes they are beautiful but from yours it could be an insecurity that I only made worse. A butterfly can't see their wings.

I miss you. I know you are right here. I know we talk almost everyday, even if it's one back and forth. But i just miss you. 

I try to forget you. Forget your face. Forget your voice. Forget your memories. But how is that even possible. I see you in anything that is objectively pretty, in every melody that makes my heart blush, in every every flower that blooms, every star that twinkles and every picture I see. You are the art, an artist myself could not paint, could not capture the beauty. Your frizzy hair, no brush has bristles to paint them. Your eyes, no tint of color could show the glitter behind them. And no canvas is worthy to hold the warmth of your soul.
I wanted to forget, I really did. Move on with my life, start talking with someone else, find someone new, talking stage, situationship and whatever. But every road lead to you, every thought lingered on you, every ounce of love I had to give, flew to you. Your crocheted pouch, and the duck cup is the first thing that I see while sitting at my desk. I love those more than anything, because expensive never meant shit to me, not even diamonds, not even riches for life trade for the value of those gifts. I love you. I yearn for you. I hate me. I even have the duck you drew on my phone cover, the moon on my phone cover is the same moon that shined when you were born. There's only one reason I stay up so late, it's the thoughts of you that consume me. Seeing you active but unable to message. We grief for what we love, it would be sad if it wasn't sad. Who cares if one more light goes out in the a sky with a million stars right? Well I do. Unfortunately for me, I always will miss you. I ask for your forgiveness, but I can't forgive myself, but I also know if it didn't happen I wouldn't be me. Oh so painful it is to live with so many dilemmas. 

It'd be easy to put the blame on someone else, flame them for what they said or what they did, I always took the easy path. Yet, it's only when I realize it really was my fault wasn't it. We only get influenced, get twisted because we are malleable. And by we, I really just mean me. It's my fault for letting things happen the way it did. The one person I truly loved, saw the crashouts because I am a child who can't get their feelings right. In the end. I really did, and became exactly what I said I wouldn't right. Exactly like other boys, possessive, wrath, and now I am finally in the deep regrets stage. Actions have consequences, but words have fatalities. I love you, but I can't have you. Sorry. I can't even be your friend. I brought it upon myself, and nothing will fix it. I know exactly why everything failed, just a little more self control, just a little more consciousness, just a little more of being thoughtful. Those little more wouldn't have come without my failures. I fucking hate that everything has to end, I envy to have everything I wish for in this life to stay with me forever, I don't want to be philosophical and say that's natural because I hate it, I hate it alot. 
I never found you ugly, gross or annoying, I loved every part of you, I tried copying you, your quirks, and what not. I don't know why but I just did. I don't know when I fell in love with you. It just happened one random day. One random night I dreamt of you, and then it felt I found for what I wasn't searching for, but needed. Obviously I told that hypothetically because that's not how my love for you started, but it feels like that's how it did, a fairy tale, a disney movie of sorts, but I really did dream about you. I loved your presence, I loved you sharing, I loved you feeling comfortable with me, I loved the secrets you shared, I loved our deep conversations, I even loved our arguements, cuz that's a serious side of dorin I love entirely by herself.

It really doesn't matter what I'm doing. All that is in my mind is you.

Maybe there were times when you thought I proved other's words/warnings right, that I am exactly the opposite of what you thought of me to be. But I really am not, anymore. I really did try to be better, maybe I did get better but I won't be my own judge. But really, I really fucking tried becoming better for you, change myself, I know I should have done it before when it really mattered, now it's just well yeah, now it's more of changes from regret. I tried changing myself, then I don't know suddenly, I became an empath, started liking more reels, thinking before I talk, talking more politely, yes im still straightforward as hell, but to a limit that I don't wish to cross. Yes im still emotionally unavailable to many people, but even that can be improved. You were wrong to say I won't change, but I never changed to prove you wrong either, never a competition, never a "see what I can do" intention. I just loved you, and when I feared losing you, I didn't lose you, I pushed you away.

You see I don't hate anyone, and I don't really get jealous either. The only exception was Razel, and only Razel. Looking back, I spent a long time trying to explain it away when it really was just jealousy. I'm completely fine with him now though. I don't know what he thinks of me, nor do I really care to know. All I know is that he's a good person. He showed sympathy for me after I got into a fight last year, and that was not what I expected at the least and that helped clear out my distaste for him even more. Now I which I don't have one bit of.

I don't know why I love you, is WHAT I WOULD SAY IF I WAS A FKING LIAR, which I am, but I know every reason to love you and even if I didn't know I would love you like there is no tomorrow, love you better than fantasy, love you better than books, but mainly I'd love you better, cuz I didn't before. I love you for who you are, it's a bullshit repetitive line but it's fucking true, its very fucking true. I love that smile of yours, that attitude of yours, the times we had together, the goodnight mwuah or whatever we did at night, the pictures you used to send, the snaps you stopped giving, the conversations we stopped having. I love you for exactly who you are, and respectfully I couldn't love someone even close to what I do now. I named my wifi after you, these are signs of obsessions but I won't sugarcoat anything, I did become obsessed of you, I wanted you to be only mine, and every bad thing resulted from it. Everything I did was just fucking dumb, crashing out without reasons, crashing out for stupid reasons, getting pissed at u ignoring, not communicating, not sending reels, being dry, all reasons were fucking stupid. My day didn't have to be all about you, but i made it that way and I got angry when it wasn't like that. I don't wanna be your boyfriend, that is a far stretch now but even before I didn't want to be one, but I acted like I was entitled to be it. I just want to be your bestfriend, YOUR bestfriend, go on hangouts and just get out at a moments call without preplanning like friends do. Shit I lost that privilege, but It's not something to be bothered about. All i can say is. I love you. I don't know what you think about me, what will happen now, or what you thought of me these couple of past months, all I know is I don't like things being unsaid, and unconfessed, so it will be even more difficult for us to talk because I still don't know what I mean to you but our physical distance and seeing each other will grow too. And for that reason, I just have one thing left to say for these past 2 years. I love you.

I am sorry for realizing everything late, and being late to confess too. And I'm especially sorry for taking everything you had done for me, with me, and just you as a whole for granted.

In the next page you can view some videos I made about/for you that I never shared. So let me take those weights off too.

Bye
-To susucumber

I'll wait for your reply. I love you.
I would totally make this my lockscreen wallpaper, but well I can't cuz people.

I love you susucumber <3
I'll wait for your reply. I love you.
